title: Perfect evaluation-mate internal Hom pullback without global scalars
statement: Let $g:T\to X$ be a scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme], let $M,N\in D(\mathcal O_X)$ [def-pc-derived-category], and assume $M$ perfect [def-pc-perfect-complex]. The canonical evaluation-mate arrow $Lg^*R\mathcal Hom_X(M,N)\to R\mathcal Hom_T(Lg^*M,Lg^*N)$ is invertible. The map transposes pullback of evaluation under [def-pc-canonical-derived-tensor-hom-bijection], preceded by the inverse tensor comparison [lem-sc-mixed-hom-tensor-pullback-iso]. This is a theorem solely in sheaf derived categories and does not require a module-category localization in the same universe.

source.place: Remark 08I3 and Example 0FPC; also perfect.tex, Tag 0AA7, case (1)

proof.text: Use quasi-coherence of a perfect object to regard M as a schemeDerivedQCohCategory object P. Obtain the natural tensor-Hom bijections on X and apply perfect_rhom_tensor_comparison to P,P. Extract its ExactPairing M D. No quasi-coherence of N is used.

The canonical family schemeDerivedTensorHomEquiv and its naturality define Adjunction.CoreHomEquiv for tensorRight M and the curried internal Hom on X; construct the same adjunction on T. The proved private definition mixedTensorHomCore verifies both naturality fields. The mkOfHomEquiv homEquiv formula and homEquiv_symm_id identify the source counit with the canonical family applied to the identity.

Take the canonicality certificate of mixedHomTensorPullbackIso from exists_mixedHomTensorPullbackIso. Apply canonicalPullbackTensor_monoidal_realization and use Iso.ext and congrArg Iso.inv to identify the inverse of the supplied tensor comparison with the monoidal tensorator.

Reuse the already proved, universe-independent private theorem monoidal_adjunct_isIso from PerfectInternalHomPullbackIsIso via import all. It applies to arbitrary tensor adjunctions and the ExactPairing obtained above, and proves the mate formed using the monoidal tensorator invertible. Its categorical counit calculation has no module localization assumption. Rewrite its target homEquiv with mkOfHomEquiv_homEquiv. Use congrArg of pullback.map on the source counit equality, and congrArg₂ of composition on the tensorator equality, to identify its evaluation arrow with the displayed arrow. Transport IsIso along this equality. This is an equality of the prescribed maps, not merely an object isomorphism.

theorem mixedPerfect_internalHom_pullback_isIso
    {T X : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ X)
    [∀ U : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (M N : schemeDerivedCategory X) (hM : Scheme.IsPerfect X M) :
    IsIso
      (((schemeDerivedTensorHomEquiv T)
        ((derivedPullback g).obj
          ((derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) X.sheaf).obj (op M, N)))
        ((derivedPullback g).obj M) ((derivedPullback g).obj N)).symm
        ((mixedHomTensorPullbackIso g).inv.app
            ((derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) X.sheaf).obj (op M, N), M) ≫
          (derivedPullback g).map
            ((schemeDerivedTensorHomEquiv X)
              ((derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) X.sheaf).obj (op M, N))
              M N (𝟙 _))))
